verdict.rationale: The docs mention an observability/events API for polling run events and a live-preview URL for human intervention (e.g. 2FA), which implies some step-by-step visibility into a run, but there is no explicit evidence of recorded video playback or screenshot timelines for post-hoc debugging of failed runs. missing for 10: explicit video recording/playback feature, screenshot capture per step, and a dedicated replay/debugging UI or docs page.
